summary: An ear-training game built on Melodee: it plays a few notes, hides some of them and asks you to play them back on the keys or over MIDI. Prototype 0.0.13.
features: C major and A natural minor, 1 to 4 notes, one octave or full range
Choose how many ending notes are hidden; enter them in order
24 FM6 sounds and 200 Prophet programs; adjustable note spacing
Scoring that weights missed degrees; scores reset on restart
Entered from Melodee with HOME + PLAY; replaces track 1's sound
Hardware revisions, timing and recovery not yet fully qualified
